merge_request.title: chore(deps): upgrade pydantic 1.10.13 -> 2.14.1
merge_request.description:
Upgrading Pydantic from 1.10.13 to 2.14.1 involved addressing multiple breaking changes across the codebase, including renaming BaseModel methods, removing or adjusting deprecated Field properties, migrating BaseSettings to its new location, replacing the Config class with model_config, updating configuration settings, and adapting validation decorators like @validator and @root_validator to their v2 equivalents. Additionally, internal attributes such as __fields__ and __validators__ were removed per deprecation notices, and union short-circuit behavior was accounted for in relevant logic. All affected files—pyshop/models.py, pyshop/settings.py, requirements.txt, and tests/test_models.py—have been updated accordingly, and the full test suite now passes. ## What changed - pydantic 1.10.13 -> 2.14.1 in requirements.txt - added pydantic-settings==2.16.1 to requirements.txt ## Code changes and why | File | Change | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | | `pyshop/models.py` | Migrate Tags to RootModel with 'root' field, replace all deprecated method names (parse_obj→model_validate, dict→model_dump, __fields__→model_fields), update Config class to model_config=ConfigDict, replace allow_mutation with frozen, fix Field default_factory for Tags, and use correct validator decorators.
Import Literal for constant field type annotation.
Replace removed frozen Field parameter with Literal type to enforce constant value "physical" per v2 migration (const/frozen removed from Field).
Access `model_fields` from the model class instead of the instance to avoid Pydantic V2.11+ deprecation warning promoted to error. | [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-field) [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) | | `pyshop/settings.py` | Migrated BaseSettings import from pydantic to pydantic-settings package, replaced Config class with model_config dict, updated env_prefix config key (no rename needed), kept Field usage compatible.
Move BaseSettings import to pydantic_settings package as required by the breaking change; keep Field import from pydantic for the gt constraint. | [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#basesettings-has-moved-to-pydantic-settings) [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) | | `tests/test_models.py` | Replace deprecated parse_obj with model_validate per pydantic v2 migration guide (BaseModel method renames).
Pydantic v2 raises ValidationError (frozen_instance) instead of TypeError when mutating a frozen model instance, as documented in the migration guide.
Replace deprecated parse_obj with model_validate for roundtrip test. | [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) | ## Documented changes that applied to this codebase - **breaking**: BaseModel method renames (breaking) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__. Where possible, we have retained the deprecated methods with their old names to help ease migration, but calling them will emit DeprecationWarning. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) - **breaking**: Field property removals/renames (breaking) (pydantic.Field) > Field no longer supports arbitrary keyword arguments to be added to the JSON schema. Instead, any extra data you want to add to the JSON schema should be passed as a dictionary to the json_schema_extra keyword argument. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-field) - **breaking**: BaseSettings relocation (breaking) (pydantic.BaseSettings) > BaseSettings has moved to a separate package, pydantic-settings. Also, the parse_env_var classmethod has been removed. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#basesettings-has-moved-to-pydantic-settings) - **breaking**: Config class -> model_config (breaking) (pydantic.BaseModel) > In Pydantic V2, to specify config on a model, you should set a class attribute called model_config to be a dict with the key/value pairs you want to be used as the config. The Pydantic V1 behavior to create a class called Config in the namespace of the parent BaseModel subclass is now deprecated. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) - **breaking**: Config setting renames (breaking) (pydantic.BaseModel) > The following config settings have been renamed: allow_population_by_field_name -> populate_by_name, anystr_lower -> str_to_lower, anystr_strip_whitespace -> str_strip_whitespace, anystr_upper -> str_to_upper, keep_untouched -> ignored_types, max_anystr_length -> str_max_length, min_anystr_length -> [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) - **deprecation**: validator/@root_validator deprecation (deprecation) (pydantic.root_validator, pydantic.validator) > @validator has been deprecated, and should be replaced with @field_validator, which provides various new features and improvements. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-validators) - **deprecation**: Deprecated: __fields__, __validators__, etc. (deprecation) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) - **behavior**: Behavior: union short-circuit change (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > In Pydantic V1, the printed result would have been x=1, since the value would pass validation as an int. In Pydantic V2, we recognize that the value is an instance of one of the cases and short-circuit the standard union validation. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-handling-of-standard-types) - **behavior**: Behavior: float->int coercion change (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > In V1, whenever a field was annotated as int, any float value would be accepted. In V2, type conversion from floats to integers is only allowed if the decimal part is zero. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#type-conversion-from-floats-to-integers) - **behavior**: Behavior: dict iterable of pairs (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Iterables of pairs (which include empty iterables) no longer pass validation for fields of type dict. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-handling-of-standard-types) - **behavior**: Behavior: Optional/Any field default logic (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Pydantic V2 changes some of the logic for specifying whether a field annotated as Optional is required or not, and now more closely matches the behavior of dataclasses. Similarly, fields annotated as Any no longer have a default value of None. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#required-optional-and-nullable-fields) - **behavior**: Behavior: regex engine change (behavior) (pydantic.Field) > Pydantic V1 used Python's regex library. Pydantic V2 uses the Rust regex crate. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-handling-of-standard-types) ## Verification - After the bare version bump: 0 passing, 2 failing of 2 collected - After Upshift's edits: **17 passing, 0 failing of 17 collected** | Attempt | Model | Edits | Result | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 2 | 0 passing, 1 failing of 1 collected | | 2 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 2 | 10 passing, 7 failing of 17 collected | | 3 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 5 | 0 passing, 1 failing of 1 collected (rolled back: worse: 0 passing, 1 failing (was 10 passing, 7 failing)) | | 4 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 5 | 16 passing, 1 failing of 17 collected | | 5 | `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b` | 1 | 17 passing, 0 failing of 17 collected | ## Review Verdict: **approve**. All breaking changes from pydantic 1.x → 2.x have been correctly migrated. The code uses the new APIs (model_validate, model_dump, model_fields, field_validator, model_validator, RootModel, ConfigDict, frozen, from_attributes, str_strip_whitespace, Literal for const fields) and the tests exercise the same inputs/calls with updated expected exceptions (ValidationError instead of TypeError for frozen instances). No weakened tests, missed migrations, compat shims, or behavior changes were found. ## Cost - Token Factory usage: $0.0807 across `nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b`, `nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning` - Evidence sources: 5 pages (2 Tavily searches) --- Generated by [Upshift](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-ai-hackathon/transcend-october-2026/43491832/nvidxnebi) with NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory. Every edit above links to the changelog or migration guide that justifies it; tests ran in an isolated sandbox.

sources.title: Automated migration tool for Pydantic v1 to v2 · pydantic/pydantic · Discussion #12772 · GitHub

entries.title: BaseModel method renames (breaking)
entries.migration: old_method -> model_old_method (e.g. dict() -> model_dump(), parse_obj() -> model_validate(), construct() -> model_construct(), copy() -> model_copy(), json() -> model_dump_json(), json_schema() -> model_json_schema())
entries.quote: Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__. Where possible, we have retained the deprecated methods with their old names to help ease migration, but calling them will emit DeprecationWarning.

entries.title: Field property removals/renames (breaking)
entries.migration: Removed: const, min_items->min_length, max_items->max_length, unique_items, allow_mutation->frozen, regex->pattern, final. Changed: alias returns None when no alias set (was field name). json_schema_extra replaces arbitrary kwargs for schema.
entries.quote: Field no longer supports arbitrary keyword arguments to be added to the JSON schema. Instead, any extra data you want to add to the JSON schema should be passed as a dictionary to the json_schema_extra keyword argument.

entries.title: BaseSettings relocation (breaking)
entries.migration: pydantic.BaseSettings -> pydantic_settings.BaseSettings (import from pydantic-settings package). parse_env_var classmethod removed; customize settings sources instead.
entries.quote: BaseSettings has moved to a separate package, pydantic-settings. Also, the parse_env_var classmethod has been removed.

entries.title: Config class -> model_config (breaking)
entries.migration: Old: class Config: ... New: model_config = ConfigDict(...) or model_config = {...}. Config class namespace is deprecated.
entries.quote: In Pydantic V2, to specify config on a model, you should set a class attribute called model_config to be a dict with the key/value pairs you want to be used as the config. The Pydantic V1 behavior to create a class called Config in the namespace of the parent BaseModel subclass is now deprecated.

entries.title: Config setting renames (breaking)
entries.migration: allow_population_by_field_name -> populate_by_name; anystr_lower -> str_to_lower; anystr_strip_whitespace -> str_strip_whitespace; anystr_upper -> str_to_upper; keep_untouched -> ignored_types; max_anystr_length -> str_max_length; min_anystr_length -> str_min_length; orm_mode -> from_attributes; schema_extra -> json_schema_extra; validate_all -> validate_default
entries.quote: The following config settings have been renamed: allow_population_by_field_name -> populate_by_name, anystr_lower -> str_to_lower, anystr_strip_whitespace -> str_strip_whitespace, anystr_upper -> str_to_upper, keep_untouched -> ignored_types, max_anystr_length -> str_max_length, min_anystr_length -> str_min_length, orm_mode -> from_attributes, schema_extra -> json_schema_extra, validate_all -> validate_default

entries.title: validator/@root_validator deprecation (deprecation)
entries.migration: @validator -> @field_validator; @root_validator -> @model_validator. New decorators have different signatures (no field/config kwargs, always=True behavior changed).
entries.quote: @validator has been deprecated, and should be replaced with @field_validator, which provides various new features and improvements.

entries.title: Deprecated: __fields__, __validators__, etc. (deprecation)
entries.migration: Old names (__fields__, __validators__, __private_attributes__, construct, copy, dict, json, parse_obj, update_forward_refs) still work but emit DeprecationWarning. Use model_* equivalents.
entries.quote: Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__.

entries.title: Behavior: union short-circuit change (behavior)
entries.migration: Union now preserves input type when possible (short-circuits). To revert to V1 left-to-right behavior, use Field(union_mode='left_to_right').
entries.quote: In Pydantic V1, the printed result would have been x=1, since the value would pass validation as an int. In Pydantic V2, we recognize that the value is an instance of one of the cases and short-circuit the standard union validation.

entries.title: Behavior: float->int coercion change (behavior)
entries.migration: Float to int conversion only allowed if decimal part is zero. Non-zero fractional part raises ValidationError.
entries.quote: In V1, whenever a field was annotated as int, any float value would be accepted. In V2, type conversion from floats to integers is only allowed if the decimal part is zero.

entries.title: Behavior: dict iterable of pairs (behavior)
entries.migration: Iterables of pairs no longer pass validation for fields of type dict.
entries.quote: Iterables of pairs (which include empty iterables) no longer pass validation for fields of type dict.

entries.title: Behavior: Optional/Any field default logic (behavior)
entries.migration: Optional/None and Any default handling changed to match dataclasses. Any no longer defaults to None.
entries.quote: Pydantic V2 changes some of the logic for specifying whether a field annotated as Optional is required or not, and now more closely matches the behavior of dataclasses. Similarly, fields annotated as Any no longer have a default value of None.

entries.title: Behavior: regex engine change (behavior)
entries.migration: Pydantic V2 uses Rust regex crate (linear time, no lookarounds/backreferences). Use regex_engine config to revert to Python regex.
entries.quote: Pydantic V1 used Python's regex library. Pydantic V2 uses the Rust regex crate.

entries.title: Deprecated: validate_arguments -> validate_call (deprecation)
entries.migration: @validate_arguments -> @validate_call. Note: attributes raw_function and validate not preserved.

payload.description:
Upgrading Pydantic from 1.10.13 to 2.14.1 involved addressing multiple breaking changes across the codebase, including renaming BaseModel methods, removing or adjusting deprecated Field properties, migrating BaseSettings to its new location, replacing the Config class with model_config, updating configuration settings, and adapting validation decorators like @validator and @root_validator to their v2 equivalents. Additionally, internal attributes such as __fields__ and __validators__ were removed per deprecation notices, and union short-circuit behavior was accounted for in relevant logic. All affected files—pyshop/models.py, pyshop/settings.py, requirements.txt, and tests/test_models.py—have been updated accordingly, and the full test suite now passes. ## What changed - pydantic 1.10.13 -> 2.14.1 in requirements.txt - added pydantic-settings==2.16.1 to requirements.txt ## Code changes and why | File | Change | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | | `pyshop/models.py` | Migrate Tags to RootModel with 'root' field, replace all deprecated method names (parse_obj→model_validate, dict→model_dump, __fields__→model_fields), update Config class to model_config=ConfigDict, replace allow_mutation with frozen, fix Field default_factory for Tags, and use correct validator decorators.
Import Literal for constant field type annotation.
Replace removed frozen Field parameter with Literal type to enforce constant value "physical" per v2 migration (const/frozen removed from Field).
Access `model_fields` from the model class instead of the instance to avoid Pydantic V2.11+ deprecation warning promoted to error. | [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-field) [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) | | `pyshop/settings.py` | Migrated BaseSettings import from pydantic to pydantic-settings package, replaced Config class with model_config dict, updated env_prefix config key (no rename needed), kept Field usage compatible.
Move BaseSettings import to pydantic_settings package as required by the breaking change; keep Field import from pydantic for the gt constraint. | [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#basesettings-has-moved-to-pydantic-settings) [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) | | `tests/test_models.py` | Replace deprecated parse_obj with model_validate per pydantic v2 migration guide (BaseModel method renames).
Pydantic v2 raises ValidationError (frozen_instance) instead of TypeError when mutating a frozen model instance, as documented in the migration guide.
Replace deprecated parse_obj with model_validate for roundtrip test. | [source](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) | ## Documented changes that applied to this codebase - **breaking**: BaseModel method renames (breaking) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__. Where possible, we have retained the deprecated methods with their old names to help ease migration, but calling them will emit DeprecationWarning. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) - **breaking**: Field property removals/renames (breaking) (pydantic.Field) > Field no longer supports arbitrary keyword arguments to be added to the JSON schema. Instead, any extra data you want to add to the JSON schema should be passed as a dictionary to the json_schema_extra keyword argument. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-field) - **breaking**: BaseSettings relocation (breaking) (pydantic.BaseSettings) > BaseSettings has moved to a separate package, pydantic-settings. Also, the parse_env_var classmethod has been removed. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#basesettings-has-moved-to-pydantic-settings) - **breaking**: Config class -> model_config (breaking) (pydantic.BaseModel) > In Pydantic V2, to specify config on a model, you should set a class attribute called model_config to be a dict with the key/value pairs you want to be used as the config. The Pydantic V1 behavior to create a class called Config in the namespace of the parent BaseModel subclass is now deprecated. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) - **breaking**: Config setting renames (breaking) (pydantic.BaseModel) > The following config settings have been renamed: allow_population_by_field_name -> populate_by_name, anystr_lower -> str_to_lower, anystr_strip_whitespace -> str_strip_whitespace, anystr_upper -> str_to_upper, keep_untouched -> ignored_types, max_anystr_length -> str_max_length, min_anystr_length -> [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-config) - **deprecation**: validator/@root_validator deprecation (deprecation) (pydantic.root_validator, pydantic.validator) > @validator has been deprecated, and should be replaced with @field_validator, which provides various new features and improvements. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-validators) - **deprecation**: Deprecated: __fields__, __validators__, etc. (deprecation) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Various method names have been changed; all non-deprecated BaseModel methods now have names matching either the format model_.* or __.*pydantic.__. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-pydantic-basemodel) - **behavior**: Behavior: union short-circuit change (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > In Pydantic V1, the printed result would have been x=1, since the value would pass validation as an int. In Pydantic V2, we recognize that the value is an instance of one of the cases and short-circuit the standard union validation. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-handling-of-standard-types) - **behavior**: Behavior: float->int coercion change (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > In V1, whenever a field was annotated as int, any float value would be accepted. In V2, type conversion from floats to integers is only allowed if the decimal part is zero. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#type-conversion-from-floats-to-integers) - **behavior**: Behavior: dict iterable of pairs (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Iterables of pairs (which include empty iterables) no longer pass validation for fields of type dict. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#changes-to-handling-of-standard-types) - **behavior**: Behavior: Optional/Any field default logic (behavior) (pydantic.BaseModel) > Pydantic V2 changes some of the logic for specifying whether a field annotated as Optional is required or not, and now more closely matches the behavior of dataclasses. [↗](https://pydantic.dev/docs/validation/latest/get-started/migration/#required-optional-and-nullable-fields) - **behavior**: Behavior: regex engine change (behavior) (pydantic.Field) > Pydantic V1 used Python's regex library.
